# Lower Eyelid Reconstruction

**Authors:** Omar Ozgur, Venkata Neelima Kothapudi, Miguel B. Sequeira Campos, Soheila Rostami

**Source:** StatPearls - StatPearls Publishing

## Abstract

The proper function of the eyelids is essential for maintaining the health and integrity of the ocular surface. Patients undergoing eyelid surgery due to malignancy, trauma, or other structural defects require special attention to preserve not only the aesthetic contour of the eyelid but also its critical roles in ocular protection, tear film distribution, and corneal lubrication.
